~Maven

notes.title: Indie Questions for the Gamers Out There...
notes.content:
So, we have been hit with the feedback "One year old game and only nine reviews, going to pass on this."  Actual feedback, so we would like to know, what do you all expect from the indie developers???

[list]
[*]Do you prefer games to be complete when released?
[/list]

Let's get a little personal;

[list]
[*]Did we communicate enough, too much or not enough?

[*]Was providing game updates throughout our development a positive or negative?
[/list]

We have been going back and forth internally, so your responses would help clear up our debates.

~Maven

notes.title: A Year and Some Change...
notes.content:
We got slammed for our PRE - ALPHA and all I can say is, I get it!  Now a year and some months later, we have pushed a game update that we stand by as indie game developers!  Support has been up and down but, we believed and still believe in Don't Bleed!

We have come a long, long, long way, from the negative feedback to positive and yes, we read it all!  We have dissected Don't Bleed and improved on it.  For those indie developers, stick with your game, it ain't easy but, if you believe in your game (in your gut) hold on!

We hope you enjoy, there is still a lot more that we have to offer you, stay tuned...

~Maven

notes.title: GAME UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
We have cross a major milestone, the Don't Bleed game update is live.  There has been a ton of updates, game design changes, and more.  Thank you for your patience and support!  We didn't quit and we are very proud of this update!  We also have more in store for you, just stick with us, it will only be getting better.

[b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] First Person to Third Person (bonus)
[*] Weapons with abilities
[*] Audio (Feedback, Background, etc.)
[*] More Characters
[*] Character Customization
[*] Weapon Customization
[*] Improved Lobby System
[*] Server by Country
[*] And More...
[/list]
[b]Public Service Announcement to those with KEYS:[/b]
[u]You better update the build![/u]
 
All we ask is that you get a group of friends to play to truly experience [b]Don't Bleed.[/b]

~Maven

notes.title: 2019 and Reality...
notes.content:

~Maven

notes.title: Audio, Audio and more Audio

And then UNITY just released the new engine :(  So, what does that mean?  It means we will have very, very late nights pushing the build into Unity 2018.3.  Please know we are still working hard to get this update out...  Thanks.

notes.title: True to the Indie Spirit
notes.content:
So, this is me venting!  I recognize we aren't AAA but, for what this team has accomplished over the past year has been extraordinary to say the least.  A small group was able to put together a game that if people played would actually enjoy!  We took an idea and with feedback from the community we made it better, with support internally we made it better, with third party contractors we made it better and with interns we made it better!

All we ask is for a chance, give us a shot, we haven't QUIT yet and won't!  We are Indie Game developers, that is why we are here, not just for glory but, for the spirit of gaming!  We are all gamers in this studio, from XBOX to PS to STEAM to MOBILE we game...  We hope you see that in us!

~Maven

notes.title: Late Night Chronicles...
notes.content:

You spoke we listened, animations have improved significantly, third person perspective (camera) has been modified, environment makes more sense now (players were like "what the hell bro, why is there a building right here?"), optimization for 15 players has been retooled for faster entry into lobby and game, so now we don't lose any players in the transition. notes.title: What is Don't Bleed?
notes.content:
Yes, we asked the question to ourselves.  We allowed each team member to respond to the question.  After that we had a healthy discussion and the result is...   Don't Bleed is a "Melee Escape" Game, not a battle royale, not a first person shooter, not a rip off of any of the other games out.    

Okay, I'm going to give you all some secrets about the game, find the flare gun as fast as possible, get a few filters (so you can breath), tactically setup the other players, avoid Leechers, beware of the traps so pay attention to where you are going!!!  Now you can't say, I didn't help you!

notes.title: Judge Us On... (this may be a little long but, it has visuals)
notes.content:
Hello, I've been posting updates throughout the development of Don't Bleed and I wanted to chat with you all about the game.  We have taken all the feedback (positive and negative) and put in the proverbial "work".  For the record, we are an indie studio with no art resources, so all our art was done by contracted artists (they did a helluva job) for the most part.  We are small but, fierce. The screenshots are currently what's in development for the game; we are aggressively addressing the bugs and gameplay issues.  Thus far we have had up to 10 players in game and the frame rate has maintained a high level.  As you can see the UI has changed drastically!  We will continue to test so when the update is released you all will be pleased with the game!  Let me be clear the game update is not the "FINAL" release, there is and will be more development ie maps, player characters, weapons and items.  We appreciate the support and look forward to giving you the best experience in this unique survival game!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402787/f53b9bd104fe9207ef3f227b08eeefec220ad191.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402787/8a2279592879ffde71a95bf4ae8698f76b9cd780.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Out of the Lab...
notes.content: Well folks, here is the news we are at the finish line getting ready for some testing.  We plan on aggressively testing Don't Bleed, so that you all will enjoy the game.  This game has gone through significant updates, we look forward to the comments and feedback!

notes.title: Breakthrough!
notes.content:
Yes, we had a breakthrough, the game has progressed significantly in the past 48 hours.  Within the next 24 hours we will have Light and Medium Leechers in game, pick up items, traps, with the necessary gameplay functionality to gameplay test with one player.  The next step is the networking, we are developing a lobby system for friends to join and play together!

These next three days will be critical...  Stay tuned...

notes.title: Progress...
notes.content:
Well after some intense investigation and debugging, we removed light baking out of the game.  It looks good in my opinion (looking forward to seeing what the testers have to say).  There is some asset popping in and out, so we will be going back through and placing certain objects in different layers within the scene.  This indie stuff is not for the weak at heart, you have to really love this, we do love making games!!!

I want to really show off the level but, I would be severely punished if I did.  :(  Trust me when I say the game is night and day from the initial release...

notes.title: Being Honest...
notes.content:
Some may say we shouldn't tell you what's going on, we should only tell you when the game update will be released.  We don't agree, you all need to know the good and bad.  Well here is some bad, we hit a frame rate issue with all the content we've added.  It hit us hard due to the fact we were making great strides.  

...More to come

notes.title: We Are Working! (This one is a little long...)
notes.content:
Hello All,
So here is an update in the development of Don't Bleed. We have Light Leecher (LL) complete and in game with AI.  We have modeled and rigged one of the two Medium Leechers (ML).  The rigged ML will get AI tonight, the second ML will be rigged and animated this week.  The Heavy Leecher (HL) will hopefully (fingers crossed) will be modeled and rigged by this Friday.

What does this mean to you all, well plan on seeing all of the Leecher classes in game on the update!  Weapons and more weapons will be present, with upgrade kits being made.  We decided to go with upgrade kits due to the fact we couldn't see the small items in game (minor game change).

We are very excited about the progress, the feedback from the community has been great and we are thankful.  We are looking forward to hearing and seeing the reviews from the update.  More to come, stay tuned...

We are currently getting all in game player animations correct.  Also another version of the Medium Leecher is being developed and our first Heavy Leecher is in development as well.  Finally, two additional play areas are being populated with props.  Stay tuned, more to come.

notes.title: Secrets of Development...
notes.content:
[b](Whispering voice)[/b]
Hey, psst.  I'm not supposed to be telling you this but, I feel updates are necessary!  

[u][b]Pros[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Terrain Environment Updates are Complete, first pass that is. What does that mean?  Well the terrain has been totally re-done!  We have also completed all external and internal props.  Second Pass of the terrain will occur in one week (meaning we are adding more prop content)...
[*]Leecher Animations Complete, now we will be integrating into game for timing and sequencing to make the Leecher movements look natural in game.
[*]Update to Unity 2018 Beta Complete but, I'll tell you later about the issues.
[/list]

[u][b]Cons[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Update to Unity 2018 Beta [b]BROKE[/b] the damn terrain (excuse my french)...  So, we are spending our time bug fixing at the moment, the problem is with how Unity 2018 is handling textures and shaders.  Jump on our DISCORD to get an ear full.
[/list]


So, visually the game has progressed significantly.  We have also managed to keep a high fps count (>50).  Oh, did I mention we got rid of the FOG!  Yes, yes, it is gone, no more fog (we only use it in the horizon by the water).  There are new options for in game player characters (yup added a female and more).

notes.title: Leechers… They are Not Zombies…
notes.content:
So, this has been the biggest misconception (or misperception) about [b]Don’t Bleed[/b].  And yes, we realize the asset pack we used were zombies (sheesh we don't have artists remember).  Leechers are mutated human beings who have been exposed to the infection for an extended period.  Prior to becoming a Leecher humans go into an incubation phase where the human body morphs due to the infection.  How does this transformation take place???  I will tell you later, for now take a look at the new concept artwork on the art page!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1284027157&fileuploadsuccess=1

notes.title: Where We Stand...
notes.content: Hello, we are in the midst of development, we have logged the bugs from everyone, we have also partnered with some artists/animators.  So, what does that mean for Don't Bleed?  It means, in the game update (now scheduled for late February 2018) there will be new animations, a new consolidated map (so players can engage with one another), new interior art assets and Leechers (#NotZombies). notes.title: GAME is LIVE on STEAM
GAME is LIVE on STEAM
Game Release… What Does That Mean?
notes.content:
So, we’ve heard from the community and there is great FEAR that we are doing a “Money Grab”.  That is not the case…  We want the community to support us with this game; the funds are specifically being used for game enhancements.  We recognize that the game is not 100% complete however; the game is at a state where core functionality is solid.  We are currently working on the art assets as well as honing the animations that you all have called out (by the way we will be adding “vaulting” to the game).

Supporting us now allows you to full access of the updates and then the final version.  When we are done the price will be subject to change…   So far you all should see we are communicating, updating and staying on track with Don’t Bleed.  We don’t plan on going anywhere; so like us, love us or hate us, we are here!!!

[u]Don’t Bleed Road Map[/u]
[olist] 
[*]Testing Key Release January 10, 2018
[*]Pre-Alpha Release January 19, 2018
[*]Pre-Alpha v1 Update February 19, 2018 
[*]Pre-Alpha v2 Update March 19, 2018
[*]Pre-Alpha v3 Update April 19, 2018
[*]Plan update will be released in April 2018

[b]***Release notes will be provided on each update***[/b]

notes.title: Timers
notes.content:
There are two timers on the island the “Random” and “Fifteen”.  The random timer is at the beginning of the game, it allows you the time to gather resources and to get your thoughts and plan together.  The issue is, it is a random time!  Also if some one decides to go full out crazy and activates a beacon then it throws you into the Fifteen!

The Fifteen-minute timer is the actually time for the game session.  This is the amount of time allotted for you and all the other players to figure out where the evacuation point will be.  So use your time wisely.

notes.title: Maps… (Internal Team Fight)
notes.content:
So we added a map to the game, I felt that a map would make the game too easy, while others (by others I mean the other designers) disagreed.  They stated the game was uber hard without a map and players would be lost and die before meeting any of the objects etc.  So, we went back and forth for a few hours and I was voted off the island; Don’t Bleed has a map now.   After numerous gameplay sessions I actually like it now, go figure the team has won me over again!  

What say you community?

notes.title: We Actually Listen!
notes.content:
Feedback from testers after initial key release…  We are logging and considering all the comments, concerns and ideas…

[olist]
[*]Animations: This is something we need help with (just being honest), this is why we are looking for the community to support what we are doing.  So in turn we can either add an experienced artist/animator or work with an animation studio.

[*]LEECHERS Attacking through Walls: We are implementing the fix for this. HOORAY

[*]Crouch & Prone: Do we need this?  Crouch and Prone don’t have any benefits in Don’t Bleed.  I’m going to need more feedback from the community on this…

[*]Press E to Pick Up: We are implementing the fix for this.  We decided to make this an option within the game.

[*]Mouse Scroll: We are implementing the fix for this.  We decided to make this an option within the game.
[/olist]

Keep the feedback coming.

notes.title: The Game p3
notes.content: … [i]Living Again[/i], we get asked all the time what does that mean?  Have you ever played a game and someone in the game kills you and no matter what you do, it seems they always have the upper hand?  Well in Don’t Bleed you only have one life (yes, only one life), so you have to be strategic about how you play however, if you die it is possible to “Live Again” in the game session.  [b]#PLAYasLEECHER[/b] end the idiot who killed you, prevent them from leaving the island.  [b]#RevengeIsFUN[/b]

notes.title: How We Define Pre-Alpha

Consider it as an EARLY ACCESS, you are getting a game with solid core gameplay features (see some of our game posts); enhancements to art (yes like we stated earlier ART is our issue) is what is coming.  However, getting in early has benefits, you get the updates for FREE; instead of paying the higher price point later on.

notes.title: 15 Player Battle Royale vs Solo Survival Game Mode
notes.content:
Don’t Bleed on Pre-Alpha Release offer two game modes Solo and Multiplayer.  The solo game mode is not a campaign (I repeat NOT A CAMPAIGN) it is exactly like multiplayer just without fourteen others trying to kill you, trap you and leave you behind.  You will have to play against the clock and a horde of LEECHERS (#NOTZOMBIES) to survive a fifteen-minute gameplay session. 

Now the multiplayer is an all out fifteen player melee (my words the team disagrees) where every player for themselves.  You will have an unspecified period of time to acquire pick-ups and then the fifteen-minute countdown starts.  What will you do?

notes.title: Don't Bleed Development Update
notes.content:
Hello,
We have been busy optimizing and bug fixing the game, we want you all to know this game has a bunch of features coming soon.  So, I will tell you all a few secrets.  This game is a cross genre game, it is not your typical first person survival.  We have taken the concept of Battle Royale, First Person Survival, Strategy/Tactical and merged them into one.   You start the game as the INFECTED!  Yes, you already have an issue from the start.  Players must be very strategic and tactical when playing; you'll notice that your health is depleting from the start.  

[b]Here are some tips:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Find survival items that help your health
[*]Use your Map (Carefully)
[*]Leechers (#NOTZOMBIES) can harm or help
[*]Activate the Beacons
[*]Get Off the Island...  Oh, only one of you can leave.
[*]... Live Again
[/olist]
